plan: Replace HomeScreenTest.kt with proper Compose UI integration tests using androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4 framework to verify app launch, loading states, video rendering, like button interaction, and vertical paging
steps: Rewrite HomeScreenTest.kt to use Compose UI testing framework (androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4) with @get:Rule ComposeTestRule and @RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
Create test to verify HomeScreen renders without crashing using ComposeTestRule.setContent
Create test to verify CircularProgressIndicator displays when isLoading=true using onNodeWithTag('loading_indicator')
Create test to verify video content displays correctly (author, description, music) by asserting text presence
Create test to verify like button is clickable and like count increments using onNodeWithTag('like_button').performClick()
Create test to verify vertical paging works with multiple videos in HomeUiState using onNodeWithTag('video_pager')
Create test to verify all action items are visible and display correct formatted counts (likes, comments, shares)
Verify test tags are properly used: 'loading_indicator' for progress, 'video_pager' for pager, 'like_button' for like button
Keep ExampleInstrumentedTest.kt unchanged as it's a valid baseline instrumentation test
